scope: Documentation and repository publication; actual application code unchanged during publication work.

python.model: deterministic double; actual temporary SQLite and Qdrant

ui.scope: Node synthetic DOM/state tests, not full browser coverage

dependency_review.limitation: Point-in-time public advisory lookup; absence of known advisories is not proof of security.

demo.scope: Fresh prior video production; not a new full-corpus evaluation

historical_gold: 21 accepted cases from 27 September full run plus explicit focused rerun; unchanged retained evidence, not rerun for documentation publication.
publication_check: Run separately on final working tree and staged contents before push; CI repeats from the published commit.
